name: Origin of Captain America — chapter I's 'It gains first strike and vigilance' is the target's, not the Saga's
notes: Found beside The Wrath of Khan. 'I — Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control. It gains first strike and vigilance until end of turn.' gave the Saga itself the keywords and the chapter had no target picker. A Saga chapter's 'it' is now the target its line names; the picker lists only your creatures.
